text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen will be Victoire 
Pisa's final race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Retirement, huh... ...It's going to feel 
lonely.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if I could hold them back even 
a little, but looking at that 
expression—it's truly all clear, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Then this is all I have to tell you. 
Let's make it a wonderful Arima Kinen, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes... I will do so as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa was satisfied with the path 
she had walked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a world where so many retire due to 
injury, if the curtain can fall like this, 
nothing could be better.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Is Orfevre not running in this upcoming 
Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista is running! Plus, I heard a 
super strong girl from Germany is coming! 
The one who won the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe by five lengths in record time—!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's even more lively this year, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So naturally, Victoire Pisa was being 
forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People turn their smiles and expectations 
toward their next hope. This current 
reality is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like the girl from that day in 
Dubai was fading away, and I just couldn't 
bring myself to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day, I found a lantern in a shop 
window.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking of putting it outside the 
window at night. Flash-san has been 
training late into the evening recently."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The dorms get quite dark around curfew. It 
might only be a small comfort, but I 
thought even a little light would bring 
some peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That ordinary lantern I saw that day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I had picked it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the trainer's office, I turn the 
knob. With a satisfying click, a soft 
light spread across the room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I place the lantern by the window. Its 
light reflects off the glass, faintly 
illuminating the darkness outside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every night, Victoire Pisa would place a 
lantern outside her window.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if they'll even notice, but 
if it can bring even a little comfort to 
their heart... That single thought was all 
it took.
choice_data_list:
(...Doing something like this is 
completely pointless.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“However, no matter what, I wanted to 
leave something of hers behind.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since I started 
placing the lantern by the window.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What is that? That thing you put on every 
night?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
My trainee seemed rather curious about it. 
If I leave it alone, it might become the 
next school mystery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just a habit of Victoire Pisa's— 
several incidents that were easily 
explained as such continued to happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Phew... Hehe, a road run off-campus is 
quite refreshing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The aroma of dinner, laughter echoing from 
the park... I can really feel everyone's 
daily lives around us.
choice_data_list:
Shall we work it into training for a 
while?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you sure it's alright?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...? —What is that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I saw a lantern 
glowing in the window of a house.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
... Did they go out of their way to put 
this here?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's some over there too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Look, over there too. ...And over that way 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Drawn along by her, I step forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Throughout the residential district, 
lanterns were lit in the windows of 
various homes."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"This is... what on earth could have 
happened...?"

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text: My, aren't you Pisa-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person who spoke to us was a homemaker 
living in the residential area.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
I'm a big fan of yours...! Though, only 
ever since Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
You know... ever since the earthquake, 
I've mostly just stayed cooped up at home. 
I just couldn't seem to find any energy.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
"That was when I watched that race. My son 
was making such a fuss over it, you see."

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
And then, it was like people from all 
sorts of countries crossed all borders and 
it was just a massive festival, wasn't it? 
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
It looked so... so sparkly to me. I was so 
happy. Even though I didn't know the first 
thing about racing back then.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, seeing that racecourse 
overflowing with such happy vibes made me 
smile naturally—

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
"And since then, I've been able to go 
outside. I've even started volunteering."

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text: Still... aren't you retiring soon?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no. It's fine. That's something they 
should decide for themselves, after all."

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Still, you know, being alone is lonely. I 
just wanted... to repay you for everything 
you've given me.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
And—oh, that's right. I started lighting 
the lanterns.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Were you... the one who lit the lanterns 
here?

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
It's not just me. Everyone around here is. 
Look—right on cue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where the woman pointed, someone was just 
about to light a lantern.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident B
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, wait!? The real deal!?

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
The real deal, absolutely! This person's 
daughter is a student at Tracen Academy, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! That's right! My daughter told me 
that these windowsill lanterns are really 
trendy right now.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident B
text_block_list.text:
I don't know her true intentions, but 
surely—

text_block_list.name: Local Resident B
text_block_list.text:
You must be praying for Pisa-san's sake, 
right...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Praying... for something of mine—?

text_block_list.name: Local Resident C
text_block_list.text:
"What's all the fuss about... wait, 
Victoire Pisa!?"

text_block_list.name: Local Resident D
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn out by the voices, residents of the 
neighborhood poke their heads out their 
windows one after another.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I've wanted to tell you this in 
person for so long!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident C
text_block_list.text:
I light the lantern every night, too. 
Because I don't ever want to forget what 
you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident C
text_block_list.text:
And... with the wish that you might run 
again someday. I poured those feelings 
into it too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa looked around at the 
lanterns glowing all around and the people 
gathered there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea that mimicking her daily 
routine had become a trend among the other 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, none of that matters right now. 
My voice inadvertently pitches up.
choice_data_list:
Your days here will surely never be 
forgotten.

I'm certain the days you spent will never 
be forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it never came to light, the hope 
connected that day had taken root and 
lived on.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “...... Yes. I somehow... what should I—”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To think that something like this... could 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I can't sleep.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I can't forget the glow of those 
lanterns.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(All this time... I was enveloped in such 
immense warmth, wasn't I?)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(“Hoping with all my heart that you'll run 
again someday”...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(My role was already over... I thought 
there was nothing left for me to achieve.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...And yet. If everyone wishes for it... 
perhaps—)
